digest.component_or_area: Copilot agent skills lint and registration
propositions: Three Copilot rebar skills (rebar-implement, rebar-janitor, rebar-debug) silently fail to register in GitHub Copilot CLI due to YAML frontmatter violations or over-length descriptions.
rebar-implement and rebar-janitor SKILL.md files have descriptions exceeding the 1024-character Agent Skills spec limit (1327 and 1068 chars respectively).
rebar-debug SKILL.md contains an unquoted colon in a plain scalar (discipline: write) that breaks YAML parsing.
A deterministic CI lint check is needed to prevent regression by validating all SKILL.md frontmatters (YAML parse, description <= 1024 chars, valid name format) at commit time.
The fix involves converting overlong descriptions to YAML folded block scalars, trimming them to spec, and adding a check_skill_frontmatter.py script invoked by make lint.
